title: MV Looking to make a multi-page stamp book

posts.author: SuperPhillip
posts.body:
Hello, everyone. I'm not too creative with eventing, even with using RPG Maker MV for a decade or so now.
Regardless, I have an optional Adventurer's Club in my game where stamps are awarded to the player, and currently it just shows how many stamps have been collected via variable (this variable rewards the protagonist's party with items upon reaching certain variable thresholds), but not WHERE the stamps have been awarded from. I'd like to create a stamp book, multi-page (maybe 2 or 3 pages) that identifies which stamps have been collected and from where, as well. If possible, I'd like to have it where the locations are revealed as the player enters them, so later locations aren't "spoiled", for lack of a better term.
Would this be possible to do through some rigorous eventing/scripting, and if so, where should I start? Additionally, I made a very rudimentary draft of the type of stamp book I'd like, just so folks can better visualize what I'm wanting.
If there's any information I've left out or if there is anything you need from me to help better, please feel free to let me know. Thank you for reading!

posts.author: LowrellLovelace
posts.body:
I think this can easily be done with just using a lot of switches (or hidden items). Make a switch for every stamp and when a player receives a stamp turn on that switch. Then make an event that will create the picture that shows the player the stamp list. Use 'show picture' on the lowest layer for a solid background and then for every check box you'll use a 'conditional branch' to check every switch we've made so far.
If true
then make a checkbox picture above the background
if else
make an empty checkbox. Make sure to change the y location incrementally for every checkbox.
SuperPhillip said:
If possible, I'd like to have it where the locations are revealed as the player enters them, so later locations aren't "spoiled", for lack of a better term.
Click to expand...
I'm having a bit of a hard time interpreting this but I think you mean you want the locations to be labeled as "???" if the player hasn't entered that area, yes? If so then you just need to make more switches that activate at the locations of that area. Then make another 'condition branch' that
if true
shows a text picture (this can be done using the TextPicture.js plugin) of that location's name next to the checkbox or
if else
just shows "???".
Put all of this in a single common event and then redo all of this for every page. To have the player be able to cycle to different pages use 'show choices' with the options "Next," "Previous," and "Leave" at the end of common event. Use 'erase picture' to delete any excess pictures and use 'erase picture' on all pictures on the "Leave" choice. Put the common event of each page in the appropriate "Next" and "Previous" choices. This should be it.
